text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ever since our previous defeat, we<n>have trained
tirelessly for this day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have fully applied myself and<n>followed your
guidance to the letter. It<n>is safe to say that we've
done<n>everything in our power.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Therefore the time for words is<n>behind us. Now we
need only show<n>the world the fruits of our labors!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That previous loss will be our last.<n>Henceforth, the
Emperor's road shall<n>be paved with victory!
